title: Business, Schemes: Swapan Dasgupta On Highlights Of BJP's 1st Bengal Budget
description: The other key initiative in the budget is the introduction of a "Pink card" for women.The new government has also cut down the minority budget from nearly Rs 5,000 crore to less than Rs 3,000 crore - a move Dasgupta said puts minorities on an equal footing with other citizens.
